_why: Settings for the lean PR reviewer (KIPI_REVIEW_LEAN=1, ASK-4743). The reviewer runs with --setting-sources '' so NO user, project or plugin settings load, which drops every context-injecting hook. A reviewer that can run Bash must still sit behind the machine-protecting gates, so exactly these are re-attached and nothing else: destructive-op deny (rm -rf, force push, reset --hard), the archived-engagement deny, and the .claude write guard. KIPI_REVIEW_SCRIPTS is exported by pr-review-agent.sh and points at the trusted control checkout, never at the PR tree under review.
